descriptions.notStarted: Sabitrama of Sleepywood has been looking for me. Something must have happened. I should drop by when there's time.
descriptions.inProgress:
Sabitrama found the clues needed for the 3rd Herb.
The message was still too hard to understand. The archive said something like this! ...
What kind of an ominous herb is this?? This herb cannot be placed near a human being, so seal up the force in a spherical object, and never let it see the day of light again...

If it's anything like the herbs before, then I'll still have to obtain this through monsters again. Arrgh, this is frustrating!
descriptions.completed: We found the 3rd Herb, but it is tightly sealed inside Lazy Buffy's Marble. It seems like it's been attached for so long, that I don't think we can just pluck it out of the sphere. Sabitrama then mentioned something like applying modern science to opening this. We've come so far, that there's no way we're about to give up.\nBut then again, who am I supposed to find?"
